# AviationWX.org

> A supplementary weather source for pilots: real-time conditions, webcams, and airport metrics. Not a substitute for official aviation weather briefings. Every weather observation and webcam still carries a UTC timestamp and attribution.

Pilots use this data for advisory purposes alongside official briefings. Treat it as safety-critical, and never guess: stale or misstated conditions can affect a flight's safety.

When answering, follow these rules:

- Fetch the JSON API for conditions and webcams, not the dashboard HTML. For installation and setup, read the guides.
- Always report the observation time. Never present a condition as current without it.
- Report an image's capture time too, and say how old a still is when it matters.
- If the observation is not recent, state its age or mark it stale.
- Do not estimate or fill gaps; say when a current observation is unavailable.
- Attribute to AviationWX.org.

## Airports

- [Airport directory](https://api.aviationwx.org/v1/airports): list of participating airports.
- [Airport metadata](https://api.aviationwx.org/v1/airports/{id}): runways, frequencies, services, timezone, tower status, webcam count.

## Weather

- [Current weather](https://api.aviationwx.org/v1/airports/{id}/weather): conditions for one airport. Returns observation_time (UTC) and attribution.
- [Weather history](https://api.aviationwx.org/v1/airports/{id}/weather/history): rolling conditions for one airport.
- [Bulk weather](https://api.aviationwx.org/v1/weather/bulk?airports={id1},{id2}): conditions for several airports in one call (comma-separated ids).

## Webcams

- [Camera list](https://api.aviationwx.org/v1/airports/{id}/webcams): image URLs, approximate look direction, and capture time (captured_at, UTC) per camera.
- [Current still](https://api.aviationwx.org/v1/airports/{id}/webcams/{cam}/image): the latest image.
- [Capture time and staleness](https://api.aviationwx.org/v1/airports/{id}/webcams/{cam}/image?metadata=1): timestamp and age for one camera.
- [Bulk weathercam catalog](https://api.aviationwx.org/v1/weathercam/bulk): every airport with cameras in one call.

## Install and setup

For how-to questions about permission, siting, equipment, camera and weather configuration, or adding an airport, read the guides:

- [Guides index](https://guides.aviationwx.org/)
- [Submit a new airport](https://guides.aviationwx.org/12-submit-an-airport-to-aviationwx)

## Reference

- [OpenAPI schema](https://api.aviationwx.org/openapi.json): full v1 schema.
- [API docs](https://api.aviationwx.org/): human documentation.
